blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-Elcac) said over 16 million Filipinos residing in areas formerly controlled by communist rebels have benefited from development projects under the Barangay Development Program (BDP). These individuals reside in about 5,638 villages formerly controlled by the Communist Party of the Philippines-New People’s Army-National Democratic Front (CPP-NPA-NDF), the task force said in a news release on Thursday.
